title: Conversation Recovery Inventory
purpose: Inventory substantial project material recovered from prior conversations so it can be compared against the repository and promoted selectively. This is not itself a declaration that every recovered item is canonical or empirically true.
scope: Primarily the last several months, with broader retrospective coverage where prior conversation context survives. Sensitive personal material is excluded unless it is directly necessary to the public project architecture.

do not duplicate concepts that already have canonical owners

separate project canon, personal interpretation, comparative analogy, documentary evidence, empirical research and speculation
prefer recovering whole frameworks and relationship structures over isolated memorable phrases
